opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of Washington.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dis*908missed for want of jurisdiction. 28 U. S. C. § 1257 (2). Treating the papers whereon the appeal was allowed as a petition for writ of certiorari as required by 28 U. S. C. § 2103, certiorari is denied.

Claude L. Dawson for appellants. Charles S. Rhyne for appellees.
